data.title: Ethereum Price Prediction: Here’s Why This ETH Bear Market is Officially Over
data.description: Ethereum (ETH) has officially broken out of its bear market with a 19% surge past the $2,000 threshold and the 200-day EMA, fueled by massive short liquidations, record ETF inflows, and the SEC’s new crypto rules.
data.keywords: Ethereum, bear market, EMA, Trading volumes
